storage.free_space_value_is_not_reported: Only the deterministic pass/fail result enters evidence so replay bytes cannot drift with ambient disk use.

storage_upper_bound.formula: For each cell, conservatively rescale the bound excerpt frame count, add codec padding for H1, apply the transform's frame/channel upper bound, multiply by signed-s16 bytes, apply wrapper overhead, then sum all cells. Required free bytes equal retained upper bound plus 2 GiB workspace plus 15 GiB reserve.
storage_upper_bound.claim_boundary: This is a conservative allocation ceiling, not a prediction of compressed size or runtime.

checkpoint_contract.addressing: Use the first two hexadecimal characters and then the complete frozen cell recipe digest plus the assigned wrapper extension.
checkpoint_contract.audio_commit: Write to a unique same-filesystem temporary file, validate wrapper and canonical analysis-decoded PCM, fsync, then rename atomically.
checkpoint_contract.checkpoint_commit: Only after the audio rename, atomically write a private sidecar binding plan, assignment, cell recipe, artifact SHA-256, artifact bytes, canonical PCM SHA-256, sample rate, channels, and frame count.
checkpoint_contract.resume: A cell is complete only when both artifact and sidecar exist and every binding, size, and hash revalidates. Ignore and remove constructor-owned incomplete temporary files.
checkpoint_contract.intermediates: Codec bitstreams and unwrapped PCM are one-cell temporaries and are deleted after their hashes and final lineage are checkpointed.
checkpoint_contract.final_private_manifest: Sort validated sidecars by frozen cell recipe digest and bind the complete set by SHA-256 outside Git.
checkpoint_contract.public_evidence: Emit counts and aggregate hashes only; exclude cell, source, member, artifact, and machine-path identities.
checkpoint_contract.features_and_scores: Forbidden during construction and checkpoint validation.

stop_conditions: A source allocation, candidate index, assignment, feasibility audit, preconditioning result, factor, toolchain, decoder, or private tool binding differs.
Any positive lacks its exact matched H0 or any generated cell lacks its identity PCM recipe source.
An assigned group has an unsupported transform or channel finding.
The conservative output upper bound plus 2 GiB workspace and 15 GiB reserve exceeds free space on the selected output volume.
A private cell, source, member, artifact, or machine-path identity enters the public report.
The two complete reports differ byte-for-byte.
A benchmark waveform, codec output, feature, score, or unopened label would be read.
authorized_next_step: Commit this plan and exact preflight generator, run two complete private metadata-only preflights against the intended external output volume, and commit only a path-free attestation if byte-identical. Do not generate benchmark audio until a successor constructor and construction authorization bind that result.
